subject: MaplePay demo sync — product roadmap reprioritization
messages:
From: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@maplepay.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: Harpreet Singh <h.singh@maplepay.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — can we set up a short demo?

Hi Diego —

Thanks for the intro last week. We had a brief sync internally and would like to see a short demo focused on inference latency and cost controls for our fraud-detection model. High level: we want to understand expected response times for 512-token requests, how batching impacts peak latency, and what controls we have for fallback behavior if capacity is constrained.

Can you do 30 minutes next week? Prefer afternoons PT. Attaching a short list of our MVP requirements so you can tailor the demo.

Cheers,
Emma
Emma Johnson
Product Manager, MaplePay
emma.johnson@maplepay.com
(415) 555-0132

Attachments: MaplePay_MVP_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet, 38 KB)

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@maplepay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — can we set up a short demo?

Hi Emma —

Thanks — got the requirements. Marissa (solutions) and Ben (AE) are looped in to tailor the demo. Would afternoon PT next Tuesday or Wednesday work for a 30-minute session? I can do 2:00–4:00 PM PT both days; Marissa can demo the latency/cost profiling and Ben will help map your MVP items to a mutual action plan.

If none of those times work, share a few slots and I’ll send a calendar invite. I’m attaching our 2-slide summary of what we’ll cover so you can share with Harpreet / your eng leads ahead of time.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
(650) 555-2298

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (pdf, 120 KB)

--
Marissa and Ben — please review the MVP file Emma attached and be ready to show: 1) a quick latency breakdown for 512 tokens; 2) batching tradeoffs at 50 rps; 3) fallback routing options. Note: likely a short discovery call, not a proof-of-concept yet.

From: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@maplepay.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — can we set up a short demo?

Diego —

Apologies for the late update. We had an urgent product leadership review today — the Q2 roadmap is being consolidated and we're pulling headcount and engineering cycles into a payments UX launch. Given that, inference work (including vendor demos / pilots) has been deprioritized for this quarter. Also, most of our core product team will be traveling for the launch week in June, which makes scheduling tough.

Can we pause the demo planning for now? If helpful, send over a short one-page exec summary (or your 2-slide recap) and I’ll keep it on file. We’d like to re-evaluate in early Q3; at that point we can open up calendar windows again.

Thanks for understanding — this is a timing/priorities issue, not a reflection on Redwood’s fit.

—Emma

On Thu, May 7, 2026 at 4:03 PM diego_fernandez@redwood.ai wrote:
> Hi Emma — circling on demo slots. Let us know a time that works.
>

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@maplepay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — can we set up a short demo?

Hi Emma —

Totally understand — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the upcoming launch. We’ll pause active scheduling and mark the opportunity as "nurture" in our pipeline for Q3 re-engagement.

Per your ask, attaching the two-slide demo summary and a one-pager you can share with leadership. If it’s helpful we can also:
- Book a 20-minute executive briefing in early July (tentative) that you can cancel without penalty; or
- Add you to a short monthly product newsletter where we share performance benchmarks and latency/cost experiments (no meetings).

Which would you prefer? If you want light touch, I’ll simply send the one-pager now and set a reminder to check back 1 July.

Best of luck on the launch week — happy to be flexible.

Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
(650) 555-2298

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (pdf, 120 KB)
